tests.name: Compressive strength — cubes supplied by client
Depth of water penetration under pressure
Moisture content by drying in ventilated oven
Fines content — wet sieving (fi 300 mm sieves)
Flakiness index — full normative sieve set
Percentage of crushed and broken surfaces
Particle density, voids, water absorption WA24
Frost resistance — 10 cycles in magnesium sulphate
Components affecting setting & hardening (setting delay, relative compressive strength S)
Dry bulk density of hardened mortar
